concerns.text: T012 and T013 implement 'empirical I/O pair extraction' via synthetic inputs, which is a semantic weakening of FR-003's explicit requirement to 'translate the original Python unit tests to JavaScript' and execute them.

T015 describes the logistic regression for snippet-difficulty as 'Optionally fit', whereas the plan.md (Phase 6, Task 1) requires this as a mandatory confounder check ('Fit a logistic regression...').
